title: Create Stuff and Things
description: A modpack with tons of create stuff and things
body:
Step into a world powered by gears, shafts, and pure imagination. All Create Stuff and Things is a modpack built around the Create Mod and its many addons, giving you limitless ways to design machines, automate systems, and build beautiful contraptions.

From massive skyships with Valkyrien Skies, to glowing worlds with shaders, to sprawling factories with moving parts everywhere—you’ll have the tools to turn your wildest engineering dreams into reality.

Whether you’re crafting a simple waterwheel or designing an entire industrial skyline, this pack keeps the focus on creativity, mechanics, and exploration.

⚙️ Features:

Core gameplay centered around Create and tons of add-ons

Seamless flight and shipbuilding with Valkyrien Skies

Beautiful visuals powered by shaders

A balance of exploration, automation, and creativity
